svg.text: Route: /admin/raw-materials · Screen: 1280 px wide desktop browser · Access: Admin and Staff (admin site, signed in)
• The whole inventory (panel feedback: every dish is made from a bill of materials). Four tabs: Raw materials, Dishes (servings) (14e), Ready-made (pieces) (14f) and Stock movements (14g);
the old Inventory page (/admin/inventory) opens the Dishes tab.
• Search finds raw materials by name and the category filter by category (Meat & seafood, Vegetables & fruit, Rice & noodles, Sauces & seasonings, Oils & fats, Dairy & eggs, Drinks & ice,
Others, each with its count); they combine with the All / Needs restock / Out of stock chips, whose counts follow them. No match: “No raw material matches “…”.” with Clear the search.
• The chips are in the address (?filter=low or ?filter=out), so the dashboard (11) links straight to them; with a chip on, ready-made items that also match are named with a link to their
tab. Admin and Staff can Adjust (14b). Only an Admin sees + Add raw material, Edit (14c) and Nutrition (14d; “✓” when set). A material not in use is dimmed with “(not in use)”.
